content.comment_body: Hello everyone, is it possible to connect two [product_name] units to a single [product_name] interface? Thanks.
No, that's not possible. Only one [product_name] base module can be connected to a [product_name] interface.

You can transfer data from one [product_name] to another and connect the other [product_name] to the communication module. I currently use four [product_name] units with my interface by connecting one module directly, then transferring data among the others via this module.

analysis.insight_summary: The discussion clarified that only a single [product_name] base module can be directly connected to one [product_name] communication interface, establishing a hardware limitation that impacts scalability and integration for users seeking multi-device connections.
analysis.user_expectations: The user hopes to connect two [product_name] base modules to a single [product_name] communication interface at the same time, aiming for a more streamlined setup and easier communication between devices.
